text:
maria.g: quick ask — I'm assembling a few saved log searches for infra dashboards. need reusable filters for org/model/route/region/status. anyone already have nice presets we can share? :eyes:

jake: yup — we have a couple in Kibana. pattern i use (structured logs):
```
service:"inference" AND org_id:12345 AND model_name:"mixtral-7b" AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:"us-east-1" AND status:[500 TO *]
```
works for 5xx digging. for more flexible model matching use wildcard: `model_name:mixtral*7b*`

carlos: if you're on Datadog logs the equivalent is:
```
service:inference AND @org_id:12345 AND @model_name:mixtral-7b AND @route:/v1/generate AND @region:us-east-1 AND status:[500 TO *]
```
(note the `@` fields we add during structured logging)

maria.g: awesome, can we standardize field names? i've seen `org`, `org_id`, `customer_id` all over. makes saved-search sharing painful.

jake: agreed — proposal: `org_id`, `model_name`, `route`, `region`, `status_code`. i'll open a tiny RFC in eng-sre-ops and add a migration checklist for log producers.

dana: FYI — for alert tuning, use saved search name + monitor. proposed monitor: 5xx rate > 0.5% of requests per org over 5m. alert runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-by-org

carlos: saved-searches i already created (Kibana):
- "SRE / 5xx by org+model" -> filter: `service:inference AND status:[500 TO *]` then group by `org_id, model_name`
- "SRE / High latency routes" -> `service:inference AND duration_ms:>500` then group by `route, model_name`
links: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#savedSearchId=5xx-by-org-model

sre-alerts-bot: New monitor suggestion posted: `inference.5xx_rate.by_org` (draft). To review: https://alerts.redwood.internal/monitors/1234

maria.g: thanks — can someone paste a compact query that filters by region and status!=200 (so excludes successful requests)? want to attach to internal doc.

jake: simple Kibana version: `service:inference AND region:"eu-west-1" AND NOT status:200`

carlos: datadog variant: `service:inference AND @region:eu-west-1 AND NOT status:200`

dana: also consider `status:[400 TO 599]` if you want client+server errors. saves using NOT.

maria.g: nice. i'll add these to the eng-sre shared saved search collection and create one named `SRE - errors by org/model/route` and share perms. cc @dana for the monitor thresholds.

jake: small tip — when creating saved searches, include `@sample_rate` field in the columns so large orgs don't explode the UI. use `sample_rate` for sampling-aware counts.

carlos: also: if you're building cross-org rollups, add `ingest_request_id` to logs so it's easy to dedupe in aggregations.

dana: pinging @maria.g — once saved, can you link to the alert draft in the monitor so reviewers see the exact query? :+1:

maria.g: will do. aim to push saved searches + link to monitor by EOD. thanks everyone! :rocket:
